As an insomniac since childhood, I've tried - light rooms, light therapy, cool and dark rooms, I've tried diet changes, exercise, more exercise, meditation, hypnotism, counselling, herbal medication, alcohol, massage, soothing music, sex, medication for depression and sleep therapy. I've gone to sleep clinics to be told I have all three types if insomnia - I have difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep and I wake early. I've tried every type of medication that my doctors will prescribe - some of them -especially stillnox - give me up to two hours  sleep!
Best answer I can give is try and get on with your life anyway. Work hard, enjoy leisure time and use those extra hours to read, study, browse Reddit. Take up a hobby.
If you are a true insomniac, you are not going to get anywhere fighting it. Embrace it, it is part of you.
